description: 30 bundled skills, 10 specialist agents, 27 slash commands, smart worktree hooks, and MCP server stubs — plan, implement, review, debug, multi-agent setup, and audit code from one plugin.

GITHUB_TOKEN.title: GitHub token for the bundled github MCP server
GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Optional. A GitHub personal access token with repo scope. Set it under Plugins > Configure; it is handed to the github MCP server as GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN and nothing else reads it. Leave it unset to keep the server off - it refuses to start without one.
